description: Setting up GMV Max on TikTok Shop takes more than flipping a switch. Here's the checklist and 30-day guardrails we actually use before spend goes live.
dek: Turning GMV Max on is the easy part. Here's what has to be true before you flip the switch, the setup steps we actually walk brands through, and what to watch in the first 30 days before you scale the budget.
author: Jackie He
keywords: how to set up GMV Max
cta_pre: Launch GMV Max the right way, the first time.
llms_summary: A step-by-step GMV Max setup checklist for TikTok Shop brands already doing real volume: the prerequisites to confirm before turning spend on (Business Center connection health, live organic and affiliate proof, product catalog readiness), the launch steps (goal and budget entry, guardrails, product selection), and what to watch in the first 30 days before scaling - anchored to three real case studies (a +112% GMV week-over-week recovery after a Business Center reconnect, a 45% month-over-month reallocation from $111K to $161K, and a first six-figure month of $100K in 26 days from stacking spend with promo and affiliates).
